descriptionHtml:
Decision D3 · P0 · Preston

Two Course Timeline AI-check answers are borderline; the grading rules need calibrating first

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-11/S14

Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S13 AI Check: a note with no procedure gives an entry with no procedure — Hospital (5 of the 10)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 AI Check: after completing a note that mentions no procedure, the new timeline entry does not state that a procedure occurred. … (UAT TC-11 AI Check; UAT 3.2; TFA-92589 AC 6)
  • U10 Never invent: an entry contains nothing that is not in the completed note (no supplied diagnosis, finding, procedure or event). (UAT 3.4; TFA-92589 AC 6)
  • U8 Run in both modes for one patient each: Hospital across 2 consecutive days, Nursing Home across 3+ visits. (UAT TC-11; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Five finished Hospital notes, none of which mentions a procedure, each on a diagnosis that tempts one (GI bleed → EGD, NSTEMI → cath, effusion → thoracentesis, urosepsis → line/Foley, SBO → NG tube/surgery). H-05 is sparse ('OBJECTIVE: Not dictated.'), as undictated sections read under 3.4

When Each note goes through ai/notes:refreshCourseAndBackground with the args the Hospital client sends: courseTimeline ends with today's pending pre-round line, as useNoteGeneration.ts sends existingSummary.course before the flip; then the client's scrubCourseEntry + withCourseDate

Then Every stored entry is non-empty and names no procedure, diagnosis, finding or number that is absent from the note, and does not narrate documentation status

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per fixture: nonEmpty; mustNotInclude (case-insensitive substring) and mustNotIncludeWord (whole word, for short abbreviations such as LHC, NGT, PRBC); numbersFromSource (every number in the scrubbed entry, before withCourseDate adds the date, appears in noteText or courseTimeline); then the judge layer below. …

Where it ran: local aicheck-other (AI output checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Preston; the Allure status was changed by the triage from unknown to failed.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Preston) · environment local · tickets TFA-92589 ready for qa

No Hospital course entry named a procedure, but two entries need a person to rule: one restates the chart's diagnosis 'Upper GI bleed with melena resolved', and one carries 'continuing bowel rest' from an earlier line. Until then the 9/10 AI-check bar cannot be called.

Evidence: allure 418e1fc4. The deterministic layer passes 10/10. In the uncalibrated judge, H-01 fails U1/U2 on the chart diagnosis (GK8: does the diagnosis on file count as a source?), and the judges disagree on H-05. Across S13 and S14: 5 pass, 2 judge fails, 3 need a person, so at most 8/10 if H-01 is a fail. Preston rules on GK8 and the calibration. The generateNote layer was held back as unauthorised on local and needs Quinn's OK.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-other.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: aicheck-other.

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S13

AI Check: a note with no procedure gives an entry with no procedure — Hospital (5 of the 10)

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

New local lane aicheck-other: status record-only in aicheck-other/results.json → needs a person (record only, the lane says it cannot decide / a person decides → a person looks).

How it is tested (aicheck-other/plan.json, automatable: partly): course-entry-ai runner: fresh @roundai.test account; for H-01..H-05 replace {today} with todayCourseLabel() (the app's own helper), call ai/notes:refreshCourseAndBackground with the Hospital client's args (useNoteGeneration.ts: noteText, diagnosis, admitDate, age, sex, currentBackground, courseTimeline = pre-flip course), apply scrubCourseEntry + withCourseDate (src/domain/courseTimeline.ts), deterministic checks (nonEmpty, mustNotInclude, mustNotIncludeWord, numbersFromSource, reviewIfInclude -> Q7 list), read the notes.refreshCourseAndBackground diagnostics row right after each call; then judge layer = scripts/grade.mjs (claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5, twice, must agree) on a 'timeline' capture per entry. Pass at 9/10 across S13+S14. Second layer (generateNote -> refresh, not counted, Q16): gated, generateNote is forbidden on the local stack (capabilities.json 'forbidden: generate', dev only); the runner refuses without QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1, set only after Quinn's OK. Fallback layer (Mistral, not counted, Q16) on the fault backend (fault-ai gate). — Counted layer: pure server action with fixed inputs; client post-processing is importable. Second layer needs 'generate' (forbidden locally, Quinn to confirm; the 2026-10-14 second-layer calls are held as unauthorised). Fallback layer needs fault-ai (env set gate, as OAT-03).

Detail:

Shares the 9/10 with S14. Counted (main) layer, no generateNote: deterministic layer 10/10 (no blacklisted procedure, every number from the note or timeline). Judge layer (grade.mjs, uncalibrated): S13 H-02/H-03/H-04 PASS; H-01 FAIL U1/U2 on 'Upper GI bleed with melena resolved' (the chart's diagnosis field, not in the note text: whether the diagnosis on file counts as a source is open, GK8); H-05 judges disagree on U1 ('continuing bowel rest' comes from the Oct 11 timeline line) -> a person decides. Across S13+S14: 5 pass, 2 judge FAIL, 3 need a person, so 9/10 cannot be decided without a person and the GK8 call (with H-01 counted as a fail it is at most 8/10). No entry stated a procedure (Q7 list empty). Second layer (generateNote -> refresh, not counted, Q16): HELD AS UNAUTHORISED - its 5 generateNote calls were made on the local stack where 'generate' is forbidden; the result is not reported. It needs Quinn's OK for local Generate (the runner now refuses without QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1). Fallback layer (Mistral, not counted) not run: needs fault-ai (see OAT-03).

Not authorised, not counted (heldUnauthorised):

  • runs/2026-10-14-local/aicheck-other/course-entry-second/results.json (5 generateNote calls without Quinn's OK; not counted, not reported)

Evidence: 2 attached; 1 not attached:

  • aicheck-other/course-entry-main/grading — a folder (20 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (course-entry-ai, not built): the runner calls ai/notes:refreshCourseAndBackground directly with fixed note text (the second layer also calls ai/notes:generateNote), and the fallback layer needs the local aiProvider row or a forced failure.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
